hooks.name: Python Syntax Check on Save
hooks.description: Byte-compiles every Python file in src/ and scripts/ whenever a .py file is saved, catching syntax errors immediately instead of at the next script run.

action.command: if(-not (Test-Path 'venv\Scripts\python.exe')){ exit 0 }; $files=@(); foreach($dir in @('src','scripts')){ if(Test-Path $dir){ $files += (Get-ChildItem -Path $dir -Recurse -Filter '*.py' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }) } }; if($files.Count -eq 0){ exit 0 }; & '.\venv\Scripts\python.exe' -m py_compile @files; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ Write-Error 'py_compile found a syntax error in src/ or scripts/ - see output above'; exit 1 }; Write-Output ("py_compile ok - {0} file(s) in src/ and scripts/ parse cleanly" -f $files.Count); exit 0
